title: Traceable Trust for action-ready artificial intelligence in bioscience
abstract: arXiv:2608.17997v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is becoming part of the working infrastructure of the biosciences. AI models can predict biomolecular structures, design proteins, rank variants, annotate images, recommend strains and optimise experimental conditions. We argue that the decision to use an AI output to guide laboratory action is a key juncture for trustworthy research and should follow a defined, reviewable process. We propose Traceable Trust as a proportionate assessment-and-design framework for this output-to-action boundary. It asks what evidence supports the output, what capability is being claimed, what agency has been delegated, what threshold authorises action, who can override it and how outcomes inform later decisions. We illustrate the framework through three case studies spanning ecosystem resources, project design and laboratory action. translated_title: 生物科学中面向行动的人工智能的可追溯信任
translated_abstract: 人工智能（AI）正成为生物科学工作基础设施的一部分。AI模型可以预测生物分子结构、设计蛋白质、对变异进行排序、注释图像、推荐菌株以及优化实验条件。我们认为，决定是否使用AI输出来指导实验室行动，是可信研究的关键节点，应遵循一个明确且可审查的过程。我们提出“可追溯信任”作为一个针对这一输出到行动边界的适度评估与设计框架。它询问：什么证据支持该输出，声称了什么能力，委托了什么代理权，什么阈值授权行动，谁可以推翻它，以及结果如何为后续决策提供信息。我们通过三个跨越生态系统资源、项目设计和实验室行动的案例研究来说明该框架。这些案例共同展示了在AI输出开始影响科学决策时，如何记录信任。
tldr: 本文提出“可追溯信任”框架，为生物科学中AI输出指导实验室行动的关键决策提供可审查的评估与设计流程，确保信任可被记录和追溯。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a "Traceable Trust" framework to provide a reviewable assessment-and-design process for key decisions where AI outputs guide laboratory actions in bioscience, ensuring trust is documented and traceable.
